# sinopia

Diagrams as code: a figure is a tree of first-class models that render to theme-aware SVG.
[Prose drafted via the loop.]{.badge .text-bg-secondary}

The figure below is drawn by sinopia and rendered live during the build — the code shown *is*
its source, so this page is a worked example of the library:

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: asis
import sinopia as S
from figkit import show

a = S.Box(24, 30, 150, 54)
b = S.Box(316, 30, 150, 54)
fig = S.Figure(490, 120,
    S.Markers("primary"),
    S.Rect(a, "success"),
    S.Text(*a.at(.5, .42), "declare", role="success", weight=True, anchor="middle"),
    S.Text(*a.at(.5, .72), "Box · Node", role="mut", size=9.5, anchor="middle"),
    S.Rect(b, "primary"),
    S.Text(*b.at(.5, .42), "render()", role="primary", weight=True, anchor="middle"),
    S.Text(*b.at(.5, .72), "themed SVG", role="mut", size=9.5, anchor="middle"),
    S.Route(a.right, b.left, "primary", shape="sweep", label="layout() computes coords"),
)
show(fig)
```
